card.name: Frequency words after a number
card.fires_on: The word "times" (or "days", "per") right after a count such as three or four, in dose frequency phrases like "four times a day". It also fires on "three" before "times".

modes.label: times after count
modes.description: The word "times" after a number in daily dosing directions.
modes.example: Adults: One or two tablets, four<< times>> daily; Pediatric patients over 4 years

modes.label: days or per in weekly schedules
modes.description: "days" or "per" in a weekly frequency phrase after a number.
modes.example: once daily for 7 days<< per>> week, or 6 mg/kg once

card.writes: It promotes words that ask how often or how long ago, suggesting a frequency or interval phrase comes next.
card.plain: It marks the spot in a dosing direction where a number of times per day or week has just been given.
